main.content:
==English==

===Etymology===
From {{bor|en|la|subscriptiō}}; {{surf|en|sub-|script|-ion|nocap=1}}. All senses reflect (either literally or figuratively) the notion of [[sign#Verb|sign]]ing one's own name [[beneath#English|beneath]] some promise or description to indicate that one [[agree#English:_concur|agrees with]] it or [[agree#English:_assent or accede|agrees to]] it.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/səbˈskɹɪpʃən/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-subscription.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{hyph|en|sub|scrip|tion}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# [[access|Access]] to a [[resource]] for a period of time, generally for [[payment]].
#: {{coi|en|'''subscription''' fee}};   {{coi|en|available by '''subscription'''}}
#: {{ux|en|I have a monthly '''subscription''' to the ''Daily Telegraph'' newspaper.}}
#: {{ux|en|My library '''subscription''' is about to expire.}}
#* {{quote-song|en|artist=The Doors|year=1967|title=When the Music’s Over|album=Strange Days|passage=Cancel my '''subscription''' to the Resurrection / Send my credentials to the House of Detention / I got some friends inside}}
## {{lb|en|attributively}} Available only by means of such [[access]].
##: {{cot|en|paywalled#Adjective<qq:often coinstantial>}}
##: {{coi|en|'''subscription''' model}};   {{coi|en|'''subscription''' content}}
# The [[formal]] [[acceptance]] of something, especially when verified with a [[signature]].
# The [[signing]] of one's name.
# Contributing or promising to contribute money to a common fund.
